names_note: no matrix held; list = the printed tip names (genera and four higher taxa: Dromaeosauridae, Enantiornithes, Euornithes; tip ages are black ovals or range bars)
gold_note: Vertical time tree: tips stand at their ages against a Myr scale and stage column at the left. Saurornithoides, Troodon and Zanabazar meet at one bar with Troodon's range bar rising from its middle: a polytomy of three. The arrow labels Paraves, Eumaniraptora, Troodontidae and Avialae point at the stems of their nodes and are kept on those nodes. 24 tips, 1 polytomies (3 children); 4 printed clade names kept as internal node labels. Sample 10 case (census 3, seed 20261274). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
